note: A7.41: athlete names replaced by a salted digest. The name was only ever a TAMPER CHECK - the row is identified by id - so the applier keeps the same guard by comparing digests. This stops the repository publishing a readable list of named athletes; it is not an anonymisation guarantee against someone who already holds the roster.

nameDigest.encoding: first 16 hex characters of sha256(salt + "|" + name)
